mapper.select:
select ma.* from mes_auxiliary ma LEFT JOIN mes_auxiliary_relevancy_wms_class marwc on ma.id = marwc.auxiliary_id and marwc.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN wms_classification wc on marwc.classify_id = wc.id and wc.bool_delete_enum = 0 where ma.bool_delete_enum = 0
and ma.basic_class = #{basicClass}
and ma.auxiliary_name like concat('%', #{auxiliaryName}, '%')
and wc.name like concat('%', #{className}, '%')
GROUP BY ma.id
